heading: Old Tax Regime: Slabs & Deductions for FY 2025-26
tldr: The old tax regime remains an option for taxpayers in FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27), despite the new regime becoming the default.
It allows a wide array of deductions and exemptions, which can significantly reduce your taxable income.
Key deductions include Section 80C, 80D, HRA, and interest on home loans under Section 24(b).
Taxpayers with substantial investments, insurance premiums, and home loan EMIs often find the old regime more beneficial.
A careful comparison of your potential tax liability under both regimes is crucial before making your choice for the financial year.
caption:
Still wondering which tax regime is right for you? Even though the new tax regime is now the default, you can still choose the old one. If you have home loans, insurance, or make certain investments, the old regime might save you more money. It lets you claim many deductions that reduce your taxable income.
